mechanism: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase isocarboxazid metabolism unpredictably and increase risk of serotonergic crisis; isocarboxazid is an MAOI with inherent hypertensive and CNS risks.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, use alternative antiretroviral regimen without cobicistat or switch to non-MAOI antidepressant with careful monitoring for hypertensive episodes and serotonin syndrome.
